FRAMEWORK · qeva:1:natural-number@1

Natural number

Natural numbers model finite counting through zero and repeated successor.

editorialnumber-theory · arithmetic
Trace this conceptSearch connections

PLAIN

The idea

Natural numbers model finite counting through zero and repeated successor.

EXACT

The compact statement

A Peano presentation gives N, 0, successor S, injectivity and nonzero-successor axioms, plus an induction principle or second-order categoricity condition.

Example

0, S(0), S(S(0)), … represent 0,1,2,…

Boundary / caveat

First-order Peano arithmetic has nonstandard models; ‘the’ natural numbers require a chosen characterization.

Assumptions

  • The declared Peano-style arithmetic context is fixed.
